title: Miso Butter Pasta
description: A salty-sweet umami bomb of white miso and butter tossed with pasta and brightened with lemon. Fifteen minutes, one pot, zero leftovers.

steps.text: Cook pasta in well-salted boiling water until al dente according to package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
In the same pot over medium heat, melt butter. Add garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant and just starting to turn golden, about 1 minute.
Whisk miso paste into 1/2 cup of the reserved pasta water until completely smooth — no lumps.
Pour the miso mixture into the pot and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the drained pasta and toss vigorously, adding more pasta water a splash at a time until the sauce is glossy and coats each strand.
Remove from heat. Add lemon juice and Parmesan, tossing until the cheese melts into the sauce.
Finish with a generous crack of black pepper and scatter scallions over the top.

_pipeline.originalInspiration: Bon Appetit's Miso Butter Pasta by Andy Baraghani
